name: Kiribati Government Data Centers (GWAN/e-Government)
developer: Government of Kiribati / Ministry of Information, Communications & Transport (MICTTD)
notes: No operational or announced commercial data center found for the Gilbert Islands. The official Kiribati National ICT Policy 2019 (MICTTD) lists 'Full government network (GWAN) and data centers' as a strategic e-Government priority, so government data centers are planned at policy level (likely Tarawa/South Tarawa, where government and telecom infrastructure concentrate) but no site, capacity, timeline, or operator has been published. Supporting connectivity context (not counted as data centers): Southern Cross NEXT submarine cable landing at Tarawa (first direct US fiber link with Kiribati), EMCS cable landing at South Tarawa (2025), and a World Bank-funded South Tarawa fiber backbone operated by BwebwerikiNet Ltd (BNL). An unverified hosting marketing page (atalnetworks.com) claims a 'Tier III data center in Tarawa', but the identical templated pages it publishes for Apia, Palau, Tonga and Nauru indicate generic SEO content with no corroborated facility; not counted as a project.

No data center/datacenter/server farm project found in targeted searches for the Line Islands (Kiritimati, Tabuaeran, Teraina). The main digital-infrastructure activity is the ADB-funded Kiritimati Cable Project (Improving Internet Connectivity in Micronesia Project, ADB 50348-001): a Southern Cross NEXT spur with a cable landing station (CLS) on Kiritimati whose construction began around late 2020 (contractor CCB Envico); this is a submarine cable landing station, not a data center. A 200kW solar system (Infratec NZ) addresses island power supply. No hyperscale, colocation, cloud, or government server-farm project was announced or found for this division.

No data center/datacenter/server farm project found in targeted searches for the Phoenix Islands (Kanton, Orona, Nikumaroro and other atolls). The division is dominated by the Phoenix Islands Protected Area (PIPA) with only a tiny permanent settlement on Kanton Island; it has no power grid, telecom hub, or announced digital infrastructure projects. No operator, capacity, approval, or construction evidence exists for any facility in this division.
